exception.justification: Justified: This observation or protected-carrier primitive executes inside the explicit operation and delivery machinery; instrumenting it recursively would make observation observe itself.

review.item_premise: This body inherits the delivery decision for observation::Operation::child. This body is admitted with default-versus-trace emission: absence of default payload emission does not imply missing instrumentation.
